chapters.reason: The paper uses Bayesian optimization to refine embeddings during inference, which aligns with the test-time optimization paradigm of treating hidden states/embeddings as fast-adapting parameters.

The method involves embedding perturbation and refinement, which is conceptually similar to the continuous latent space exploration and denoising/optimization found in embedding-based diffusion models.
The paper focuses on improving reasoning capabilities and accuracy in LLMs through a novel search framework, which is a direct application of recurrent/iterative reasoning techniques.
